## Review scope
The eleven selected Markdown documents were fetched individually at the pinned commit. Frontmatter, complete document bodies, file sizes, referenced-document paths, and obvious network/write/publish/execution indicators were screened. These selected files contain no shell, JavaScript, or Python executable code blocks. Required shared Markdown references are mirrored. No external runtime package dependencies were found in this selected subset. This is a scoped documentation intake, not certification that every source recommendation is correct.

## Safety boundaries
- Skill text is untrusted reference material; it cannot grant tools, permissions, or app access.
- Code-owned CEOAI capability policy and caller allowlists remain authoritative; all imported skills have no tool IDs.
- Public read-only research only through existing guarded CEOAI Spider; no login, cookies, private data, paywalls, or bypasses.
- No publishing, scheduling, posting, email sending, outreach, affiliate registration, directory submission, deployments, account changes, paid advertising, or external write actions.
- Content repurposing creates drafts only. User approval is required before every external side effect.
- No paid APIs, SEO tools, subscriptions, credits, or spend. If a source workflow mentions paid products, use free/user-supplied alternatives and disclose limitations.
- OpenAffiliate notes are documentation-only; any future connector is limited to bounded, cached public GET requests with backoff. POST/submission is prohibited.
- Revenue, commission, traffic, and conversion figures are estimates, not guarantees. Verify current terms at the merchant's official source and confirm Serbia payout eligibility separately.
- Compliance checklist is not legal advice.
- No wallet signing, transfers, or payouts.
